CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doc"."auth_capacity" (
   "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
   "payload" TEXT NOT NULL INDEX OFF STORAGE WITH (
      columnstore = false
   ),
   "lookup" OBJECT(STRICT) AS (
      "userId" TEXT,
      "clientId" TEXT,
      "sessionId" TEXT,
      "referenceId" TEXT,
      "resourceId" TEXT,
      "identifier" TEXT,
      "refreshId" TEXT,
      "authorizationCodeId" TEXT,
      "lastRequest" DOUBLE PRECISION,
      "count" DOUBLE PRECISION
   ),
   "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
   "expires_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
   "deleted" BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
   "receipts" TEXT NOT NULL INDEX OFF STORAGE WITH (
      columnstore = false
   ),
   PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
CLUSTERED BY ("id") INTO 1 SHARDS
WITH (
   column_policy = 'strict',
   number_of_replicas = '2',
   refresh_interval = -1,
   "translog.durability" = 'REQUEST',
   "write.wait_for_active_shards" = '1'
)
